newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana share index weathers Ashanti fall.
newsitem.headline: Ghana share index weathers Ashanti fall.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange weathered a fall in the price of market heavyweight Ashanti Goldfields Co on Wednesday to finish virtually unchanged, its market report showed.

The GSE All-Share Index, which jumped 1.42 points on Monday after President Jerry Rawlings's reelection in polls praised by foreign observers as well-organised, rose 0.06 points on Wednesday to close at 359.91 points.
Dealers blamed the Ashanti fall (-200 cedis to 23,000 cedis) on falling prices on world markets where it is also quoted. Ashanti was the lone loser in Wednesday's session.
Turnover fell from 218,800 on Monday to 60,920. Shares offered totalled 567,340, bids stood at 220,820.
